prose.text: **What the block runs, in order:** 1. The formatter and the linter. 2. The root binaries' units, then the adopt unit cases filtered. 3. The new integration cases by their prefix. 4. The readers of the moved literals and tables. 5. The folded binary under the `ci` profile. 6. The R5 script's parse and its rehearsal. 7. The host read. 8. The harness's three layers. 9. The gated reading. 10. The operator pass.

**What is not run, and why:** - No `round` or `live` entry: R5 is the operator's act, fired once on his word through the `operator` entries 20–22,   never by implement (`inputs#I1` items 1 and 8). - No boot smoke: no boot-path file changes. `src/cmd/run.rs` and `src/run/` are untouched, and `adopt` hands   `run::start` a `Launch` as `revive` does (research §Files to modify). - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 9). - No fuzz target: no new parser. - No `cargo deny`: no dependency edge moves.

**Must-pass readings owed to implement:** - Entry 9 asserts literals step 12's script prints. Its first firing after the script exists, before any graded use,   is the reading of entries 9, 21 and 22: the rehearsal prints the same verdict lines the live arms do. - Entry 7's atoms are the renamed cases' names and nextest's summary. They are read from the local run archived at   `target/run-archive/641`, whose summary line reads `5 tests run: 5 passed, 0 skipped`.

**Records made outside the block:** - Entry 14 reads `evidence/r5.md`, which the operator writes from R5's output (step 13). - Entry 19 reads `evidence/ci-fold.md`'s coverage lines, which the operator pass appends (step 11).
Neither entry carries an `artifact`.

**The remove-the-guard controls** are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries. Each runs `--timeout 900` against its own filtered entry, which reaches its case past fail-fast by `--no-fail-fast`. Each case fails on its own bounded assertion, so a `timeout` reading would NOT read the guard as held.

| id | File | The edit removes | Case | Entry | |---|---|---|---|---| | `adopt-live` | `src/cmd/adopt.rs` | the live-elsewhere reading in the preflight (its closure answers no refusal) | `adopt_of_a_session_open_in_another_claude_is_session_live` | 5 | | `adopt-shape` | `src/cmd/adopt.rs` | the session-id value parser on the positional id (a plain `String`) | `adopt_with_a_malformed_id_is_a_usage_error` | 5 | | `adopt-order` | `src/cmd/adopt.rs` | the holder reading's early return in the preflight order fn | `adopt_preflight_order_a_refused_holder_takes_no_agents_read` | 4 | | `adopt-parent` | `src/cmd/adopt.rs` | `checked`'s parent-equals-name refusal | `adopt_args_refuse_as_usage` | 4 |
